title: Poor magnetic strength
text:
Poor magnetic strength. The magnetic power on these spoons is woefully disappointing. I looked everywhere to replace my Martha Stewart set which has strong magnets. I'd lost the 1/2 teaspoon and the tablespoon plastic is cracked after 10 years of use.
Unfortunately this set is thin metal and poor magnetic strength--they don't hold together by any means. I tried just taking the 1/2 teaspoon and adding it to my other set but the weak magnet compromises that set too. Sad.
Kind of a waste since I end up not using them. They're scattered in the back of my drawer because they won't hold together and I'm still using my previous set sans 1/2 teaspoon.
